caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top. The lantern is oriented upright, with the conical section forming the upper part, which is topped by a circular loop handle. The handle is attached at the apex of the cone. The surface of the lantern, including the conical top and the cylindrical body, is covered with rows and patterns of small perforations, which are organized into geometric designs such as rows of dots and starburst shapes on the door panel at the front. The lantern has a small, rectangular latch for securing the hinged door. The overall color of the drawing is in grayscale, with the lantern shaded in various tones of gray to depict its metallic appearance and texture. The background is uniform and off-white, with no additional objects or shading. The artist's signature, "E. Williams," is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pierced Tin Lantern
